title: Choose the next research action under explicit resource limits
claim: Within a registered energy decision setting, the structured protocol improves consequential research choices under comparable resource caps against credible alternatives.
methods: Define a useful service, decision, beneficiary and boundary.
Keep competing predictions and initial judgments before sharing where feasible.
Compare decision value, reliability and separate resource constraints; unknown is not zero.
Check feasibility, safety, authority and cost before prerecording and acting.
Assess evidence, preserve dissent, record actual costs and choose again, wait or stop.
stop_trigger: After two reasoning rounds without a decision-relevant change, pause for a recorded continuation justification. This provisional trigger is unvalidated.
limits: Agreement, confidence, hashes and citations do not establish truth.
No result in the energy program proves this process is superior.
No autonomous execution, recruitment or spending.
